title: English Practice Quiz 0946
description: A ten-question English practice quiz covering grammar, vocabulary and practical communication.

questions.question: Quality control is used to check whether a product or service ___.
questions.explanation: Quality control checks conformity with requirements.

questions.question: A standard operating procedure is commonly abbreviated as ___.
questions.explanation: SOP stands for standard operating procedure.

questions.question: A checklist supports quality by helping staff ___.
questions.explanation: Checklists make required steps easier to follow consistently.

questions.question: A non-conformance is a failure to meet a ___.
questions.explanation: Non-conformance means a requirement has not been fulfilled.

questions.question: An audit is a systematic examination of ___.
questions.explanation: Audits assess evidence against defined criteria.

questions.question: Corrective action is intended to ___.
options: address the cause of a detected problem
questions.explanation: Corrective action aims to prevent recurrence by addressing causes.

questions.question: A quality objective should be ___.
questions.explanation: Clear objectives help an organisation monitor performance.

questions.question: Customer satisfaction can be measured using ___.
questions.explanation: Feedback and service indicators provide evidence of customer experience.

questions.question: A process review should use ___.
questions.explanation: Evidence supports fair and useful process evaluation.

questions.question: Continuous improvement means making ___.
options: ongoing efforts to improve processes and results
one change and never reviewing it
questions.explanation: Continuous improvement involves repeated evaluation and refinement.
